data.name: MotifApp.WarningsSeverityError
data.comment: Severity of a grammar finding: error.

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsSeverityWarning

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsSeverityNote

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsUnnamedItem

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsNone

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsReachMembersPartial

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsReachNone

data.comment: Explains that none of the chosen words uses the item a warning names.

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsReachNoRoute

data.name: MotifApp.WarningsReachNoSubject

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressPreparing
data.comment: Parse progress before the first word is parsed.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressWordsDoneFormat
data.comment: Parse progress; {0} is how many words are done and {1} how many there are.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressWordsDoneParsingFormat
data.comment: Parse progress; {0} is how many words are done, {1} how many there are and {2} the word being parsed; the dot is a separator.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStatusParsingFormat
data.comment: Parse status line; {0} is how many words are done, {1} how many there are and {2} the time estimate; the dots are separators.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressComplete
data.comment: Parse status once the Assessment finished. Assessment is a feature name.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressTimeFinishing

data.comment: Parse time estimate before enough words have been parsed.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressElapsedFormat

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedWordsPattern
data.comment: Plural pattern: how many words stopped during the parse; # is the count.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedTimedOutAfterFormat
data.value: {0} stopped at the time safety net after {1} s ({2})
data.comment: Parse progress: words that stopped at the time safety net; {0} is how many words, {1} the time safety net in seconds and {2} the last such word.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedTimedOutFormat
data.value: {0} stopped at the time safety net ({1})
data.comment: Parse progress: words that stopped at the time safety net; {0} is how many words and {1} the last such word.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedMemoryLimitFormat
data.comment: Words whose parser reached the memory limit; {0} is the count and {1} the last word.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedAtMemoryLimit

data.comment: Why a word stopped: the parser reached its memory limit.

data.name: MotifApp.ProgressStoppedSearchLimitFormat

data.comment: Warning shown when a parse has stalled for longer than the word time limit plus 10 seconds.

data.comment: Short status label for a Proposal that has not been tried yet.

data.comment: Short status label for a Proposal whose Trial still describes it.

data.name: MotifApp.TrialNeedsAnotherTryStatus
data.comment: Short status label for a Proposal whose Trial is out of date.

data.name: MotifApp.TrialProposalChangedOldNumbers
data.value: From the last try, before this Proposal changed
data.comment: Caption above numbers that came from a Trial run before the Proposal changed.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalParserMissing
data.value: Motif could not find PanGloss, so it cannot measure words. Install PanGloss beside Motif, then try again.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal about PanGloss not being found. PanGloss is the parser product name; FieldWorks is a product name; .motif.db and .fwdata are file extensions.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalParserMissingDetailsFormat
data.value: Motif looked for {0} and it was not there. Where Motif looked is in the problem report: choose Report a Problem, tick Include Local Details, then copy the report.
data.comment: Details the window shows for a refusal about PanGloss not being found. {0} is the parser's file name, such as pangloss.exe, without a folder. Report a Problem and Include Local Details are quoted UI labels: translate them exactly as MotifApp.ReportProblem and MotifApp.IncludeLocalDetails (the part before the bracket) are translated. PanGloss is the parser product name.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalParserUnusable
data.value: Motif could not run PanGloss, so it cannot measure words. Review a problem report for technical details.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal about PanGloss not being runnable. PanGloss is the parser product name; FieldWorks is a product name; .motif.db and .fwdata are file extensions.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalParserWrong
data.value: PanGloss gave an answer Motif could not read. Install the PanGloss that matches this Motif, then try again.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal about an answer from PanGloss Motif could not read. PanGloss is the parser product name; FieldWorks is a product name; .motif.db and .fwdata are file extensions.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalStoreUpgradable
data.value: This project's Motif store is from an older version. Refresh the project to upgrade it; the original is kept as a .bak file, and your FieldWorks project is not touched.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when a read found an older Motif store that a normal open upgrades. FieldWorks is a product name; .bak is a file extension.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalStoreFromOtherVersion
data.value: Motif cannot open this store. Delete it and reopen the project to continue. Changes not applied yet are lost; your FieldWorks project is not touched.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal about a Motif store written by another version of Motif. PanGloss is the parser product name; FieldWorks is a product name; .motif.db and .fwdata are file extensions.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalTextStyleUnknown
data.value: This text uses a style the FieldWorks project does not have, so the change was not added. Choose another style, or add the style in FieldWorks first.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.TextStyleUnknown. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalTextFieldStale
data.value: This text was changed in FieldWorks since you began editing it, so nothing was applied. Edit it again from the current text.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.TextFieldStale. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalStoreDamaged
data.value: Motif's file for this project is damaged. Close every Motif window and keep a copy of the matching .motif.db file beside the project's .fwdata file for support. Remove only that Motif store if you can confirm it belongs to Motif, then reopen the project. Changes not applied yet are lost; your FieldWorks project is not touched. If you cannot confirm the file belongs to Motif, leave it in place and ask for help.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal about a damaged Motif store. PanGloss is the parser product name; FieldWorks is a product name; .motif.db and .fwdata are file extensions.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalGeneric
data.value: Motif could not complete this request. Review the project and try again.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows for a refusal code it has no specific sentence for.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyAppliedContentMismatch
data.value: Applying may have completed, but the project could not be verified. Check it before retrying.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyAppliedContentMismatch. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyChangeNoLongerFits
data.value: One or more changes no longer fit. Remove those changes first.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyChangeNoLongerFits. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyChangeUncertain
data.value: This change needs another check before it can be applied.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyChangeUncertain. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyChangesChanged
data.value: The changes changed. Refresh them before applying.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyChangesChanged. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyDrift
data.value: Applying may have completed, but the project could not be verified. Check it before retrying.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyDrift. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyDroppedGrammar
data.value: The check found grammar the parser left out. Fix what it names, in the changes or in FieldWorks, then try again.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyDroppedGrammar. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalApplyDryRunMissing
data.value: The check did not give enough evidence to apply these changes. Check them again.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ApplyDryRunMissing. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.name: MotifApp.RefusalProposalClosed
data.value: These changes were already applied or closed, so their notes cannot be edited.
data.comment: Sentence the window shows when the command refuses with code C.ProposalClosed. Product names (PanGloss, FieldWorks, Motif, AI Handoff) stay as written; Baseline, Selection and Text are Motif terms.

data.comment: Tooltip on a Diagnostics group heading. {0} is the PanGloss rule code, which stays untranslated.

data.name: MotifApp.HealthBarFormat
data.comment: Status bar: grammar finding counts that need a person, errors then warnings. {0} is the errors phrase and {1} the warnings phrase, each already counted and pluralised. The Diagnostics summary line uses the same phrases.

data.name: MotifApp.OccurrencesApproveChooseReading
data.comment: Word panel: the disabled Approve button's text while the word has several readings and none is chosen.

data.name: MotifApp.OccurrencesApproveCheckPlace
data.comment: Word panel: the disabled Approve button's text when a reading is chosen but no place is checked.

data.name: MotifApp.OccurrencesApproveNothing
data.comment: Word panel: the disabled Approve button's text when the word has no reading to approve.

data.name: MotifApp.WordReadingsButtonName
data.comment: Accessible name of the small count of readings beside a word in the Texts reader; choosing it opens the word panel.

data.name: MotifApp.WordReadingsTipPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# reading. Open the word panel to approve it.} other {# readings. Open the word panel to choose one to approve.}}
data.comment: Hover sentence on the count of readings beside a word in the Texts reader. {0} is the number of readings.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalStatusDraft
data.value: This Draft has not been checked yet. Check what applying it does to the numbers.
data.comment: Status at the top of a pending Draft's page: its changes have not been measured.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalStatusReady
data.value: This Proposal is ready. You can apply it.
data.comment: Status at the top of a Proposal's page when the checklist is complete and nothing blocks Apply.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalApplyNeedsDifference
data.value: Apply is unavailable: no Difference has been made yet. Choose Make Difference at the top of this page, then come back to apply.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalApplyDifferenceUnavailable
data.value: Apply is unavailable: this Proposal's Difference is not available. Refresh the project and reopen this Proposal.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalLostApprovedTitle
data.value: Approved Words That Would Stop Parsing
data.comment: Heading above the list of approved words the Trial no longer parses, at the top of a Proposal's evidence.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalLostApprovedCountPattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# approved word would stop parsing if you apply this Proposal.} other {# approved words would stop parsing if you apply this Proposal.}}
data.comment: Sentence under the lost-words heading; the count is the one Apply states. {0} is the number of words.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalLostApprovedMorePattern
data.value: {0, plural, one {# more word is counted but not listed.} other {# more words are counted but not listed.}}
data.comment: Said under the lost-words list when more words are lost than the list names. {0} is how many are not named.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalLostApprovedPlaceFormat
data.comment: A lost word's places; {0} is the count of places, such as "3 occurrences", and {1} is the title of the compared Text.

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalsFilterChipFormat

data.name: MotifApp.ProposalsDeferredEmpty
data.comment: Shown when the Deferred filter is chosen and no Proposal is deferred.

data.name: MotifApp.GuideListAmbiguous
